summary: Backend + frontend testing of the new Lovreski USER PROFILE (7-section rewrite). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_profile.py with 15 pytest cases covering /profile/me/stats, photo upload / oversize / non-image / max-4 cap, reorder, delete + 404, /profile/location, interests cap (10/11), new gender values (non_binary, prefer_not), and age gate. 14/15 passed. Frontend: registered a fresh user via API, injected lovreski_token, drove /profile via Playwright — all 23 required data-testids are present; height sheet slider + save persists to DB; goal sheet with 4 opts + opt-goal-friendship works; interests sheet renders 58 chips across 8 categories, counter updates live; view/edit toggle works both directions; name field auto-save persists on blur; photo upload via input then delete via btn-delete-photo-0 works (0→1→0); coin-card navigates to /premium; completion% displays and matches backend /profile/me/stats.

critical.issue: Age-gate check on lines 456-459 of server.py is DEAD CODE — ProfileUpdate Pydantic model (lines 158-179) does not include a `dob` field, so `if 'dob' in update` is always false. Submitting dob for a 12-year-old returns 200 instead of 400. Fix: add `dob: Optional[str] = None` to ProfileUpdate.

ui_bugs.issue: Completion% is fetched only on mount (useEffect deps=[user?.user_id]). After auto-saves via saveField/refresh, the completion-pct value does NOT refresh — user must reload the page to see progress. Fix: re-fetch /profile/me/stats after each saveField, or add form dependency to the effect.

issues: photo-slot delete button uses opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 which is unreachable on touch devices (mobile-only app). Consider always-visible small trash overlay on mobile.

action_items: HIGH: Add `dob: Optional[str] = None` to ProfileUpdate model in server.py so the age-18+ gate actually triggers.
MEDIUM: Refresh /profile/me/stats after auto-save so completion% updates live without reload.
LOW: Make photo-slot trash button visible on tap (opacity-0 group-hover only works on hover-capable devices).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ProfileUpdate lacks `dob`; the calc_age(update['dob']) branch never executes → 18+ enforcement bypass for existing users.
ProfilePage.jsx line 42-49: /profile/me/stats fetched only on user_id change; edits don't retrigger. Consider useEffect deps=[user] or explicit refetch after saveField.
server.py delete_photo uses `find_one` + in-memory pop + `update_one $set photos` — not atomic under concurrent deletes. Consider `$pull` by index, or optimistic concurrency.
server.py upload_photo max-4 check is not atomic (read-modify-write). Two concurrent uploads could exceed 4. Consider `$push` with `$position/$slice` or a compare-and-set.
ProfilePage.jsx line 118: age = new Date().getFullYear() - year — ignores month/day so off by 1 for people whose birthday hasn't happened yet.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Auth token localStorage key = 'lovreski_token'. To bypass Landing signup UI, register via POST /api/auth/register and inject the token into localStorage before navigating to /profile. Profile testids are all present and stable. The only backend failure is dob age-gate (see action item #1). Playwright interests-sheet backdrop intercepts pointer events for subsequent clicks — always close the sheet (Escape doesn't close it; click the X button or backdrop) before interacting with other controls.
rca of the issue: Age-gate bypass: `PUT /api/profile` accepts a JSON body validated by `ProfileUpdate`. That Pydantic model omits `dob`, so `body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` never contains 'dob'. The guard `if 'dob' in update: ... if age < 18: raise 400` is unreachable. Repro: PUT /api/profile with {"dob":"2015-01-01"} → 200. Fix: add `dob: Optional[str] = None` to the ProfileUpdate class.
